ordered_except: drip: if timestamp > rho then rpow/suck/exit/write chi,rho else nChi = chi; always emit Drip (remainder when timestamp > rho)
deposit: shares = floor(assets * RAY / nChi) then _mint
_mint: invalid-address require; usds.transferFrom; unchecked share/supply under overflow premises; Deposit then Transfer
redeem: assets = floor(shares * nChi / RAY) then _burn
_burn: insufficient-balance; allowance if owner != sender; unchecked share/supply decrease; usds.transfer; Transfer then Withdraw

obligations.statement: Under chi > 0 and assets * RAY < 2^256, convertToShares and deposit (stable-time nChi = chi) equal Rounding.divideNat .down (assets * RAY) chi, equivalently mulDiv .down under that product premise.
obligations.not: unbounded mulDiv as source semantics when assets * RAY overflows

obligations.statement: Under chi > 0 and shares * chi < 2^256, mint/previewMint assets equal _divup(shares * chi, RAY), i.e. Rounding.divideNat .up.
Redeem assets equal floor(shares * chi / RAY) under the same product premise.
Withdraw shares equal _divup(assets * RAY, chi) under the product premise.
Public deposit/mint success is drip then conversion then _mint in that order. invalid-address refuses before transferFrom. transferFrom is required before share/supply updates.
obligations.not: source comment 'shares totalSupply will always be <= usds totalSupply' as a proved invariant

obligations.statement: Public redeem/withdraw success is drip then conversion then _burn. insufficient-balance and insufficient-allowance (owner != sender, finite allowance) are source refusals. usds.transfer is after share burn; its success is not asset-credit proof without observing USDS balances.

On deposit, if assets * RAY >= 2^256 then the 0.8.21 checked multiplication refuses (Panic 0x11). Lean Operations.mul at width 256 refuses mulOverflow. Rounding.mulDiv unbounded product MUST NOT be equated to that source refusal.

Vault deposit Typed template instantiates execute_ok_iff with USDS conservation (sender -assets, vault +assets, supply 0) and sUSDS mint (receiver +shares, supply +shares). Premises are e.Valid from those deltas, not a desired post-state assumed as hypothesis.

Token0 quote-register template instantiates the same execute_ok_iff. Ordinary add (2^96,1,1,true) is a nonzero debit/supply decrease of 2^95 of QuoteSqrtP. Source token0 observations remain four inputs plus uint160|revert. The register is not Uniswap storage.
A world with +shares and +sUSDS supply and unchanged vault USDS is not e.Valid for the deposit template. This is the source-independent mint-without-asset-credit negative.
